name: pi-intent
description: Intent UX and design strategy skills and agents adapted for pi.

scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python python -B -m pytest
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings tests skills/wireframe/references/viewer.js && mise exec -- ruff check skills/present/references/build_deck.py tests/present
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --deny-warnings tests skills/wireframe/references/viewer.js && mise exec -- ruff check --fix skills/present/references/build_deck.py tests/present
scripts.typecheck: mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python ty check skills/present/references/build_deck.py tests/present
scripts.format: biome format --write . && mise exec -- ruff format skills/present/references/build_deck.py tests/present
scripts.format:check: biome format . && mise exec -- ruff format --check skills/present/references/build_deck.py tests/present
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
